WITH demographics AS (
    SELECT
        customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
        customer_demographics.cd_marital_status AS cd_marital_status,
        customer_demographics.cd_education_status AS cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (customer_demographics.cd_marital_status, customer_demographics.cd_education_status) IN (('D', 'Primary'), ('S', 'College'), ('U', 'Advanced Degree'))
),
ws AS (
    SELECT
        web_sales.ws_item_sk AS ws_item_sk,
        web_sales.ws_order_number AS ws_order_number,
        web_sales.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
        web_sales.ws_web_page_sk AS ws_web_page_sk,
        web_sales.ws_sales_price AS ws_sales_price,
        web_sales.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998
      AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
wr AS (
    SELECT
        web_returns.wr_item_sk AS wr_item_sk,
        web_returns.wr_order_number AS wr_order_number,
        web_returns.wr_refunded_cash AS wr_refunded_cash,
        web_returns.wr_fee AS wr_fee,
        web_returns.wr_reason_sk AS wr_reason_sk,
        web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
        web_returns.wr_returning_cdemo_sk AS wr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk AS wr_refunded_addr_sk,
        customer_address.ca_state AS ca_state
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    WHERE customer_address.ca_country = 'United States'
      AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
)
SELECT
    SUBSTRING(reason.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM wr
JOIN demographics AS cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN demographics AS cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page ON web_page.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
JOIN reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
  AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
  AND (
      (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
      OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
      OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
  )
  AND (
      (wr.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
      OR (wr.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
      OR (wr.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
  )
GROUP BY reason.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUBSTRING(reason.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
